label: PIM
notes: PIM Version 2 message header (RFC 7761 §4.1, PIM-SM) over IP protocol 103. The 4-byte fixed header is modelled in full: version and type share byte 0 as masked views, then the reserved byte and the 16-bit checksum (the RFC 1071 internet checksum over the whole PIM message; no IPv4 pseudo-header). Everything after byte 4 is message-specific and variable: Hello options, Join/Prune encoded group and source lists and Register payloads have no fixed offsets. PIM-DM (RFC 3973) reuses this header and adds the Graft, Graft-Ack and State Refresh types. PIM over IPv6 shares protocol number 103 but computes the checksum over the IPv6 pseudo-header, so this IPv4-anchored entry does not cover it.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: PIM version; 2 in every PIMv2 message.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Message type; 0-5 per RFC 7761 §4.9, 6-9 are PIM-DM per RFC 3973.

fields.label: Reserved
fields.description: Reserved; set to zero on transmission and ignored on receipt.

fields.label: Checksum
fields.description: Standard internet checksum over the whole PIM message.
